results.title: Song Results
optionDesc.flashing: When off, flashing effects are disabled during gameplay.
optionDesc.CustomFade:
Choose the transition animation style (three available):
Slide = left/right banners sweep in horizontally; Meteor = panels push in with a diagonal themed light band sweeping past; Glitter = a full-screen effect fades in and out.
optionDesc.CustomFadeText: When off, the engine version and event indicator are no longer shown during transitions.
optionDesc.camZooms: When off, the camera no longer zooms on the beat.
optionDesc.camSmooth: How smoothly the camera moves on section or event changes: Snappy = settles in 0.3s (closest to the original feel); Standard = 0.5s; Smooth = 0.8s (most noticeable glide).
optionDesc.menuBeatBump: When on, screens that play background music (main menu, story mode, freeplay) bounce slightly on the beat.
optionDesc.pauseMusic: Choose the music played when entering the pause menu:
optionDesc.checkForUpdates: When on, the engine automatically checks whether a newer version is available.
optionDesc.updateNotify: When off, the update screen no longer appears when a new version is found (updates are still checked).
optionDesc.discordRPC: When off, Discord no longer shows this app as "Playing", avoiding accidental leaks.
optionDesc.downScroll: When on, the interface flips vertically and notes fall from the top.
optionDesc.middleScroll: When on, both strums are centered.
optionDesc.opponentStrums: When off, the opponent's arrows are not shown.
optionDesc.ghostTapping: When on, mashing when there is nothing to hit will not count as a Miss.
optionDesc.sbIconBop: When on, enables the SB Engine style icon bounce.
optionDesc.keIconBop: When on, enables the Kade Engine style icon bounce (scales up each beat then springs back).
optionDesc.smoothHealth: When on, health bar changes are smoother.
optionDesc.healthBarOverlay: When on, a shadow layer is drawn over the health bar.
optionDesc.minimalHealthBar: When on, hides the health bar icons and shadow, moves the health bar to the Score bar position, and embeds the Score text inside the bar.
optionDesc.oldHealthBar: When on, uses the legacy health bar style (fill clipped to the bar shape, background drawn by the bar itself) for compatibility with 0.6.3 and older mod scripts.
optionDesc.newHealthBar: When on, the health bar draws itself instead of using a texture (white border + inner fill) and automatically merges with 0.6.3 compatibility mode (no shadow).
optionDesc.autoPause: When on, the game pauses automatically when the window loses focus (switched to the background).
optionDesc.noReset: When on, pressing the reset key does nothing.
optionDesc.restartNoChartReload: When on, restarting no longer reloads the chart (no disk read, no scene rebuild) for a smoother restart.
optionDesc.rewindOnRestart: When quick-restarting, on-screen notes fly back to the start like rewinding time before the song restarts.
optionDesc.lowQuality: When on, disables some background detail to shorten load time and improve performance.
optionDesc.antialiasing: When off, antialiasing is disabled for sharper edges and better performance.
optionDesc.shaders: When off, shader effects are disabled. Shaders are used for some visual effects but are CPU-heavy on weaker machines.
optionDesc.cacheOnGPU: When on, textures are cached on the GPU to reduce memory usage (turn off if your GPU is weak).
optionDesc.preRenderNotes: When on, all note textures are pre-rendered while loading the song, greatly improving dense note charts (at the cost of load time).
optionDesc.holdCover: Show a hold cover animation on the judgement line when hitting sustains (native port of the QT mod NoteHoldCover; can be turned off).
optionDesc.runtimePack: Packs textures of 160px or smaller into a shared runtime atlas (fewer textures and draw batches; experimental, turn off if textures look wrong).
optionDesc.backgroundScale: Scale factor for large standalone backgrounds (stage/menu backgrounds). 0.5 = 50% (saves a lot of memory, slightly softer background).
optionDesc.highDPIRender: 2x crisp rendering (sharp on Retina; roughly 700-1400 fps on large charts). Off = 1x high performance (slightly blurry, roughly 3x framerate for an easy 2200+). Requires a game restart to take effect.
optionDesc.perfMode: Seiun-style fast note path: notes skip the RGB shader, use ColorTransform for tinting and batch directly into quads (removes shader binding overhead, greatly raising framerate on large charts; note colors become a flat single color instead of a three-stop gradient).
optionDesc.closeAnimEnabled: Plays a closing animation before the window actually closes when you click the window close button (X) or press Alt+F4; the game exits after the animation finishes. Not applicable on mobile.
optionDesc.closeAnimStyle: Window transform used by the exit animation: Squash = squash height then width; Scale = shrink toward the center; Fall = shrink while falling; Slide = shrink while sliding off to the left.
optionDesc.closeAnimSpeed: Playback speed multiplier for the exit animation: 1.0 is the default, higher values play faster (0.25x - 5.0x).
optionDesc.themeIndex:
Choose the interface theme color (a fixed set of 10, applied to the three primary/secondary/tertiary tokens of system UI and some accent elements):
Cyan / Blue / Purple / Magenta / Orange / Gold / Green / Teal / Red / Pink
Changes apply immediately on this page; other screens pick up the new palette the next time you enter them.
optionDesc.hideHud: When on, HUD elements such as the health bar are hidden.
optionDesc.scoreTxtFont: Choose the font used for the score text:
optionDesc.scoreTxtFormat: Customize the Score bar text format. Available variables: {score} {misses} {rank} {accuracy} {nps} {fc} {combo} {health}. Press confirm to open the text box.
optionDesc.hideWatermark: When on, the watermark in the bottom-left corner is hidden.
optionDesc.timeBarType: Choose the time bar display style:
optionDesc.newTimeBarStyle: When on, the time bar becomes a black rounded style. Fill color of the elapsed portion: uses the opponent icon color when "Time Bar Follows Opponent" is on, otherwise the theme color (with a brightness fallback).
optionDesc.timeBarOpponentColors: When on, the time bar fill follows the opponent's health bar color (with brightness fallback); when off it uses the current theme color. This switch affects both time bar styles.
optionDesc.healthBarAlpha: Adjust the opacity of the health bar.
optionDesc.comboStacking: When off, rating and combo numbers no longer stack, saving system memory and making charts easier to read.
optionDesc.showFPS: When off, the frame rate counter (FPS) is not shown.
optionDesc.fpsInTitleBar: When on, FPS/memory/peak memory/CPU are shown in the window title bar and the on-screen counter is hidden.
optionDesc.showVer: When off, the engine version below the frame rate counter is not shown.
optionDesc.fpsColor: Choose the FPS counter color; "Auto" changes color with the framerate (green at high, yellow at mid, red at low), and "Rainbow" is the Kade Engine style cycling rainbow.
optionDesc.showScrollSpeed: When on, the current note scroll speed is shown below the FPS counter, colored by speed (green slow, yellow medium, red fast).
optionDesc.showNPS: When on, the Score bar shows notes per second received (NPS) so you can check your reading speed (excludes sustains, updates every second).
optionDesc.showJudgementCounter: When on, the top-right corner shows total hits, combo, and Marvelous/Sick/Good/Bad/Shit/Misses counts.
optionDesc.iconFlyOverflow:
When on, any stacked hit (2+ note clusters, even without exceeding 100%) triggers this: the health readout bursts by the health % provided by that stack (larger stacks go higher, up to 1000%), and the icon flies out of the bar proportionally before being slowly pulled back.
The bar cap is still 100%; only the display and flight rhythm change.
optionDesc.hitsoundVolume: Plays a "ding!" hitsound when a note is pressed.
optionDesc.ratingOffset: Adjust the early/late range required for a "Sick!"; higher values require pressing later.
optionDesc.sickWindow: The hittable time window for a Sick! judgement (milliseconds).
optionDesc.goodWindow: The hittable time window for a Good judgement (milliseconds).
optionDesc.badWindow: The hittable time window for a Bad judgement (milliseconds).
optionDesc.safeFrames: Number of frames you may press early or late, judging more leniently as this grows.
optionDesc.noteJudgment: Choose the note judgement system: PE judgement is the engine's original; KE judgement is Kade Engine's (shorter early window, with 45/90/135ms rating windows scaled by safe frames).
optionDesc.marvelousJudgement: When on, the top judgement (Sick/45ms) shows the Marvelous texture (KE 1.8 style).
optionDesc.splashSkin: Choose the note hit particle style:
optionDesc.splashAlpha: Adjust the opacity of the note hit particles.
optionDesc.skipGhostNotes:
When on, repeated arrows on the same lane within the merge window are merged into one note (counted with a density value),
which greatly reduces parse and render cost on 150k-note stacked charts; normal charts have no repeated arrows and are unaffected.
optionDesc.ghostDensity:
On: merged notes score/count by arrow count (score, combo and Miss match the real arrows);
Off: repeated arrows are simply dropped (H-Slice ghost mode).
optionDesc.ghostRange: Arrows on the same lane whose time difference is within this value count as stacked. 15 is recommended; higher merges more, lower is more conservative.
optionDesc.optimizeSpawnNote:
When on, notes already past their spawn window during a time skip or quick restart are silently consumed (no Miss, no splash),
which pairs with fast chart skip; normal per-frame spawning is unaffected.
optionDesc.bulkSkip: When on, skipping time uses a binary search to skip whole spans of already-passed notes instead of removing them one by one (no more stutter when jumping on 150k-note charts).
optionDesc.fastSort:
When on, only visible notes are sorted each frame (draw order), reducing sort cost to O(visible count) on large charts.
Off by default to keep draw order identical to previous versions.
optionDesc.limitNotes:
Limits how many note objects exist at once (0 = unlimited). Use it to prevent memory blowups on stacked charts;
once the limit is reached later notes are dropped (no judgement).
optionDesc.hideOverlapped:
A later note on the same lane closer than this value is hidden (render culling, no judgement),
where 0 = off. Turning it on greatly reduces render cost on extreme stacked charts.
optionDesc.botplayScheduledHits:
When on, botplay hits use a "schedule on spawn, enqueue on time" architecture (the key to 100% coverage on large charts).
Off falls back to per-frame enqueueing (old behavior, lower coverage on dense charts).
optionDesc.botplayPopMargin:
Pop window = frame step + margin. Must be >= the kill window, otherwise killing before popping causes missed hits;
the lower the framerate, the larger this should be (a measurable frame step is 1000/FPS).
optionDesc.botplayKillWindow: How long an unhit arrow survives past the judgement line (smaller hugs the line more closely; a value below the pop margin can race and drop hits).
optionDesc.spawnNoteEvent:
When off, spawning notes no longer fires the Lua/Hscript onSpawnNote callback (saves enormous callback overhead on 150k-note stacked charts);
keep it on if your mod scripts rely on that callback.
optionDesc.hudOnly:
When on, only notes and the HUD are rendered (characters, stages, rain and the rest of the scene are skipped, as are stage scripts), greatly raising framerate;
keep it off for mods that rely on stage visuals or stage scripts.
optionDesc.enableGC: Turning it off removes GC spikes (memory may rise); on by default to match previous behavior.
optionDesc.opponentLightStrum: Whether the strum highlights confirm when the opponent hits; off saves a little drawing.
optionDesc.botLightStrum: Whether the player strum highlights confirm on botplay hits; off saves drawing.
optionDesc.playerLightStrum: Whether the player strum highlights on manual hits/presses; off saves drawing.
optionDesc.ratingPopups: Whether rating popups (Sick/Good...) are created on hits; when off scoring still works, with less visual feedback.
optionDesc.comboPopups: Whether combo numbers and the Combo word are created on hits; when off combo still counts normally.
optionDesc.lessBotLag: During botplay, only score/rate without creating rating and combo popups (fewer sprite creations and less GC pressure).
optionDesc.noHitFuncs:
Hitting notes no longer fires the Lua/Hscript goodNoteHit/opponentNoteHit callbacks;
keep it on for mods that rely on these callbacks (such as scoring or effect scripts).
optionDesc.cneScripting:
Master switch. When on, Meteoric loads the CNE-style HScript scripting layer:
state scripts (data/states/<StateClassName>/LIB_<mod>.hx), global scripts (data/global/LIB_<mod>.hx),
ModState/ModSubState, state redirects and script hot reload.
⚠ Scripts can reach engine APIs like Sys/File; enable only for mods you trust. Off means zero behavior change.
optionDesc.cneStateScripts:
Allows each engine screen to load its own HScript: data/states/<StateClassName>/LIB_<mod>.hx.
Scripts can hook create/update/stepHit/beatHit/destroy (requires the scripting layer to be on first).
optionDesc.cneGlobalScripts:
Allows persistent HScript: data/global/LIB_<mod>.hx.
Global scripts run across screens and can be used for global UI, event buses and whole-song logic (requires the scripting layer to be on first).
optionDesc.cneModStates:
Allows writing entire screens in HScript: new ModState("MyState") / new ModSubState("MySubState").
Scripts live in data/states/MyState/LIB_<mod>.hx; this is the key entry point for "make a standalone game without recompiling the engine".
optionDesc.cneStateRedirects:
Allows mods to replace engine screens with their own HScript screens via flags.ini [StateRedirects] / [StateRedirects.force].
This rewrites state switch requests and is higher risk, so it is off by default.
optionDesc.cneHotReload:
When on: F5 reloads the current screen's scripts; Shift+F5 rebuilds the global scripts.
The first version follows CNE semantics faithfully (F5 re-enters the current screen/song) without restarting the game.
optionDesc.cneScriptClasses:
Allows HScript to define classes and extend engine classes inside scripts (SScript EX mode).
Turning it off reduces the risk of scripts reaching into engine internals.
optionDesc.cneScriptLogs: When on, prints script load/destroy/reload records to the console for debugging (off by default to avoid spam).
optionDesc.psych063Mode: When on, disables forced note baking to match the arrow texture format of Psych Engine 0.6.3 mods (try this if arrows are invisible).
optionDesc.luaUse063Compat:
When on, Lua script stop sentinels use the numeric Psych Engine 0.6.3 convention (Function_Continue=0 / Function_Stop=1 / Function_StopLua=2).
Try this when `return Function_StopLua` in older 0.6.3 mods fails to stop the script.

options.hint.noteOffset:
Beat calibration treats the metronome as the measured subject (it needs a fullscreen beat animation and offset feedback), so it stays a separate fullscreen screen.
Click it in the left rail to open it directly (pressing Enter on keyboard selection works too); you return to the pause menu automatically afterwards (when entered from a song).
options.hint.hudCustomize:
HUD customization is a fullscreen drag editor (drag the health bar / score / time bar and save their positions), so it stays a separate fullscreen screen.
Click it in the left rail to open it directly (pressing Enter on keyboard selection works too).
options.hint.containers:
Container management is a separate fullscreen screen (list + details + action bar): containers ship their own engine UI, so you jump straight to it.
Click it in the left rail to open it directly (pressing Enter on keyboard selection works too). Note: launching a container restarts Meteoric entirely, so it does not fit as a subpage inside the options screen.
options.hint.mobileTouch:
The touch control layout is a separate fullscreen editor (drag the buttons and save the layout).
Click it in the left rail to open it directly (pressing A on keyboard selection works too).
